overview: A modern Smart Attendance Management System for colleges featuring role-based dashboards for students and teachers, dynamic QR-based attendance with anti-proxy 10-second rotation, assignment management with file uploads, and attendance analytics with interactive charts — all wrapped in a premium glassmorphism UI with dark/light mode.
features: Internet Identity login with student/teacher role selection
Dynamic QR attendance — rotates every 10 seconds with anti-proxy validation
Student dashboard with attendance percentage and period tracking
Teacher dashboard with class monitoring and QR management
Assignment upload and download via file storage
Attendance analytics with interactive Recharts charts
Responsive glassmorphism UI with sidebar navigation
Protected routes with role-based access control
